test_title: PYST 25: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic: ​

Option (1): EBD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd7b0ca112662413a8d1235c1002bfc36444ca3d3e4d2e2950d7fdb91c5f5ff1.png] 

Option (2): LIK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6fcd7f111aa2589e198d65f228ba0d6ad591d139cbf2ecd4146324bd304ed03.png] 

Option (3): ROS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfaed579552653da8d6693ed22bad90b8c2df19a18cf15e74e2cf46e117ab271.png] 

Option (4): PMO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c723270a3d5f96a5fdd208cb88f2b402d5725a97713defe7bbfbc57f96451846.png] 

Thus, out of all the options "ROS" is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
